atleta.meta.title: Athlete – Vicente Romero
atleta.meta.desc: The story and results of Vicente Romero: ISA European Champion, two-time Spanish Champion and WQS Zarautz Pro winner.
atleta.hero.sub: Professional surfer. European Champion and two-time Spanish Champion.
atleta.bio.title: About me
atleta.bio.p1: I'm Vicente Romero Carrau. I was born in Florianópolis (Brazil) and thanks to surfing, the sport I do professionally, I've travelled to and discovered the best beaches in the world. Although I grew up in Brazil, I've lived in Spain for many years and I have Catalan and Argentine roots. This mix of nationalities and cultures often makes me feel like a citizen of the world.
atleta.bio.p2: I first stood on a board at the age of five and surfed my first waves at Barra da Lagoa, my home town. From a very young age I developed a special bond with surfing and the sea. When I was eight we moved for the first time to Sitges, a small town on the Catalan coast where my grandparents lived, and ever since I've been moving between Spain and Brazil.
atleta.career.title: From Florianópolis to Europe
atleta.bio.p3: In Florianópolis I was already standing out in local contests, and at 19, when I settled in Sitges again, I started getting results at European and international level. Since those first achievements I've kept progressing in the sport and, little by little, reached some of the milestones I had dreamed of as a child.
atleta.ach.title: Achievements
atleta.goal: I'm still chasing new dreams: making the CT and becoming an Olympian.
atleta.gallery.title: In the water and on the podium

trip.name: Surf Experience Morocco
trip.meta.title: Surf Trip Morocco · 15–22 December – Vicente Romero
trip.meta.desc: Surf Experience Morocco with Vicente Romero: a week of surfing, coaching and video analysis for all levels. 15–22 December 2026, €860. Limited spots.
trip.hero.sub: Surf, coaching and a unique experience.
trip.b1: Surf trips designed to connect, learn and enjoy.
trip.b2: An authentic, carefully curated and personalised surf experience.
trip.b3: Mindful surfing in one of the best destinations in the world.
trip.intro.title: A week of surfing in Morocco
trip.intro.p1: Enjoy a week of surfing in Morocco alongside Vicente Romero, professional surfer, European Champion and Spanish Champion.
trip.intro.p2: An experience designed for all levels, combining surfing, technical training and professional guidance with the aim of improving, having fun and sharing great moments in and out of the water.
trip.intro.p3: The difference is that Vicente Romero is there for the whole trip, bringing his experience as a professional surfer and coach.
trip.who.title: Who is it for?
trip.who.p: The Surf Experience is open to all levels, from those taking their first steps in surfing to intermediate surfers who want to keep progressing. We'll split the groups by level to adapt the sessions to each surfer.
trip.beg.p: The beginner group will be accompanied by the instructors of Triángulo Surf Marruecos, who will run the sessions and follow each participant's progress.
trip.g3: Guidance and teaching in the water.
trip.g4: Progression adapted to each surfer's level.
trip.beg.goal: The goal: gain confidence, learn the basics and enjoy surfing in a safe and fun environment.
trip.int.title: Intermediate
trip.int.p: The intermediate group will be accompanied by Vicente Romero and a local guide, looking every day for the best conditions and spots for the group's level.
trip.i4: Video analysis to identify areas for improvement.
trip.int.goal: The goal: understand your surfing better, correct technical details and apply what you've learned in the next sessions.
trip.together.title: We share much more than waves
trip.together.p: Although the groups are organised by level, there will be sessions and moments we can all enjoy together. Improving matters, but what matters most is that you have a great time, meet people, enjoy the atmosphere and live surfing to the fullest.
trip.stay.title: Accommodation
trip.stay.p1: We'll stay at Triángulo Surf Marruecos, a comfortable aparthotel with apartments for up to six people, arranged in double rooms.
trip.stay.p2: A private room can be booked, subject to availability and for a supplement.
trip.inc.title: What's included?
trip.n2: Breakfast, lunch and dinner throughout the stay.
trip.n4: Transport for the sessions and planned outings.
trip.n6: Surf coaching and guidance in the water.
trip.n7: Video analysis for the intermediate group.
trip.n8: Local guide and knowledge of the best spots.
trip.n9: All surf equipment for the beginner group.
trip.n10: Vicente Romero with you throughout the trip.
trip.n12: Day trip to Imsouane (lunch not included).
trip.n13: Visit to the dunes, with the option of sandboarding (rental: about €5).
trip.n14: Visit to the Souk, the local market.
trip.n15: Visit to the village of Taghazout.
trip.n16: Option to visit a local waterfall, depending on the weather and the state of the area.
trip.exc.title: What's not included?
trip.x2: Travel insurance covering sports, including surfing. This insurance is mandatory to take part.
trip.act.title: Activities and experiences
trip.act.lead: The Surf Experience is much more than the surf sessions: we'll also discover some of the most special places in the area and its local culture.
trip.act1.p: A day in Imsouane enjoying its atmosphere, its beaches and the local fresh fish. (Lunch not included.)
trip.act2.p: We'll visit the dunes and you can try sandboarding. (Rental: about €5.)
trip.act3.p: We'll wander the local market to discover its products, its atmosphere and the local culture.
trip.act4.p: We'll get to know the streets and the vibe of this iconic surf village.
trip.act5.p: Depending on the weather and the state of the area, we may visit a local waterfall.
trip.gallery.title: What the trip looks like
trip.book.title: Are you coming?
trip.book.p: A week to surf, learn, progress and have fun in one of the most special surf destinations. Technical training, professional guidance, local culture and good times in and out of the water.
